name: VictoriaLogs
summary: Search your server's and apps' logs in the browser, with live tail, history and a cap on disk use.
description: The Apache-2.0 VictoriaLogs log database from VictoriaMetrics, packaged from a pinned upstream release with its web UI (open /select/vmui/). The Automaton API, Worker and Runners send their logs to it over OpenTelemetry when Logging__Otlp__Endpoint points at this app. It keeps 14 days and at most 5 GiB of logs by default.

application.description: Search your server's and apps' logs in the browser, with live tail, history and a cap on disk use.

settings.name: RETENTION_PERIOD
settings.description: How long logs are kept, for example 14d, 4w or 1d. Older days are dropped.

settings.name: MAX_DISK_SPACE_BYTES
settings.description: At most this much disk for logs, for example 5GiB or 500MiB; the oldest days are dropped first. 0 turns the cap off.

settings.name: LOGS_URL
settings.description: Address the Home card Action uses to ask this app for recent errors, for example http://<this app's internal address>:9428. Empty: the Home card stays off.
